title: The Ball in the Well
lines: Bill has a red ball and a tall hill.
He rolls the ball off the top.
"Dad! The ball fell in!" yells Bill.
Dad dips a net in the well.
He tugs and tugs and gets the ball.
"Your ball is a mess," said Dad.
"I want to fill a tub," said Bill.

questions.listenFor: In a well. It is stated in the story - if they guess, have them find the line with the word well in it.

questions.ask: How does Dad get the ball back?
questions.listenFor: He dips a net in the well and tugs. Follow up with "and how did Dad know to come?" to see if they linked the yell to the help.

questions.ask: Why do you think Bill wants to fill a tub? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any reason tied to the story works - "the ball is a mess" shows they connected the ending back to the well.
